meta.name: Delhi Crime
meta.description:
Following the police force as they investigate high-profile crimes in Delhi, this series has seasons inspired by both real and fictional events.

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7 | S2 5/5 | S3 6/6

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After two victims of a brutal crime are found on a roadside, DCP Vartika Chaturvedi assigns only her most trusted officers to lead the investigation.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: With few leads to go on, Vartika's team focuses on identifying the exact bus where the crime occurred. Media leaks trigger backlash against the police.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Disturbing details about the night of the crime emerge when bus driver Jai Singh is interrogated further. The hunt begins for his five accomplices.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The fourth suspect is captured. As public outrage mounts, Vartika and Commissioner Kumar Vijay must defend the police against rumors of misconduct.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The pursuit of the final two suspects escalates. Vartika must manage the team’s anger, her child’s fears and her own guilt. Kumar faces irate activists.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Male victim Akash is tempted to speak to the media, to Vartika’s dismay. The chief minister continues with his mission to take down Vartika and Kumar.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The fifth suspect surprises the police. Protests outside Parliament become riots. The search for the final suspect leads to a chase in Naxal territory.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Vartika and her team are alerted about a gruesome quadruple murder. Evidence points to a crime syndicate not seen in the city for 20 years.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: After another murder, veteran inspector Viren Chaddha joins the team. As case details leak to the press, Vartika suspects an informant among the police.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The team's investigation of two suspects leads to eye-opening findings. Amid pressure to appease the media and the public, Vartika faces a moral dilemma.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Against a ticking clock, Vartika takes the case in a new direction. Neeti finds a common link between the murders. Another tip-off leads to a suspect.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The team finds the suspects' hideout. But with Lata still missing, Vartika must determine if she's running or hiding — and finally uncover her story.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After her transfer to Assam, Vartika unearths a network smuggling young women to Delhi under the guise of jobs. Neeti probes an injured baby's case.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Vartika's investigation uncovers deeper connections as Khushi reveals startling truths about Baby Noor. Kalyani's court hearing takes a shocking turn.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview:
Rahul's confessions about working with Kalyani help the team draw links to the bride trade.

Neeti and Simran edge closer to the missing mother's location.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The hunt for Shabnam intensifies, revealing fresh leads. Kusum gets bail and meets Meena. A deeper probe into the Santro car lands Simran in trouble.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As Vartika's meeting with Mithul Khanna goes awry, Shabnam has a tearful reunion with her children. Neeti searches for her missing colleague.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Shaken by tragic news, the team races to find the missing women as Vartika's career hangs in the balance. Will they catch Meena before all hope is lost?
